## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/). A pull request with unsigned commits cannot be merged.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest` passes, and I added a test for the change.
- [ ] Commits written with an AI assistant start with `ai: `, and I have read the diff.
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies, no new network calls, and no changes to install files, build scripts or workflows. (If one of those is needed, I opened an issue first.)
- [ ] No real people, companies or email addresses in code, tests or docs: only fictional names and example.com.
- [ ] If a user would notice the change, I updated `src/hermitcrm/help/changelog.md`.
